name: draw-diagram
description: Drafts the boxes and arrows of an Excalidraw diagram from one sentence the member types, for the drawing editor's Draft with AI.

fields.name: title
fields.description: A short name for the diagram, at most 60 characters

fields.name: nodes
fields.description: The boxes of the diagram, one item each

item.name: id
item.description: A short unique id for the box: n1, n2, n3 and so on

item.name: label
item.description: What the box says, at most 60 characters

item.name: kind
item.description: decision when the box asks a question and the arrows leaving it are its answers, otherwise step

fields.name: edges
fields.description: The arrows between boxes, one item each

item.name: from
item.description: The id of the box the arrow starts at

item.name: to
item.description: The id of the box the arrow points to

item.name: label
item.description: What the arrow says, at most 40 characters; empty when it needs none
